confirmed_weaknesses.summary: Worker failure recovery is not implemented although documented: jobs that fail stay 'running'.
Test suite overstates coverage: the worker path has no test oracle.

development_plan.action: Enforce MAX_ATTEMPTS using the attempts column; move exhausted jobs to a 'failed' state; requeue on transient errors.
development_plan.success_criterion: A test that injects a failing handler observes attempts == MAX_ATTEMPTS and state == 'failed'.
development_plan.title: Make retries real
development_plan.why: Failed jobs are stranded in 'running', which silently loses work.

development_plan.action: Add worker tests for success, handler exception and empty queue; rename or remove test_worker_runs.
development_plan.success_criterion: Coverage of worker.py at 100% of branches, enforced in CI.
development_plan.title: Test the worker, not just the store
development_plan.why: The riskiest path has no oracle and a misleading test name.

development_plan.action: Review the other contributor's HTTP changes through pull requests and document a contribution guide for the store API.
development_plan.success_criterion: At least five substantive reviews and one merged guide authored by the candidate.
development_plan.title: Make collaboration visible
development_plan.why: Scope and influence are not observable here, which blocks levels that require them.

development_plan.action: Write ADR 002 comparing row-level leasing in SQLite vs. Postgres SKIP LOCKED with a measured benchmark.
development_plan.success_criterion: ADR with a reproducible benchmark showing claims/sec for 1, 2 and 4 workers.
development_plan.title: Design the multi-worker path
development_plan.why: The ADR names the single-host ceiling as the revisit trigger.

summary: Alice built queuebox's durable core: a SQLite job store with forward-version-guarded migrations (E-001), a lock-serialised claim path that guards the state transition in SQL (E-002), and an ADR that records the rejected Postgres option and the throughput ceiling the design accepts (E-004). The migration refactor (E-008) shows the store evolving without breaking existing files. The weak points are concrete: test_worker_runs never calls the worker, so the worker's failure path is untested (E-005), and the worker declares MAX_ATTEMPTS but never enforces it, contradicting its 'bounded retries' docstring (E-006). Collaboration and technical leadership have no evidence in this repository even though another contributor was present; the HTTP module is theirs and is not credited (E-009). Security was not exercised by any inspected code.
